title: NCERT Class 10 Physics
description: Prerequisite DAG for NCERT Class 10 Physics covering Light, Electricity, and Magnetism

concepts.name: Reflection and Refraction of Light
concepts.description: Fundamental laws of reflection and refraction of light

concepts.name: Spherical Mirrors and Image Formation
concepts.description: Concave and convex mirrors, ray diagrams, and image characteristics

concepts.name: Mirror Formula and Magnification
concepts.description: Relationship between object distance, image distance, and focal length for spherical mirrors

concepts.name: Refraction through Spherical Lenses
concepts.description: Convex and concave lenses, principal focus, optical centre, and ray diagrams

concepts.name: Lens Formula and Power of a Lens
concepts.description: Lens formula, linear magnification, and dioptre power of lenses

concepts.name: Electric Charge
concepts.description: Nature of electric charges, elementary charge, and conservation of charge

concepts.name: Electric Current and Circuits
concepts.description: Rate of flow of electric charges in a closed electric circuit (I = Q / t)

concepts.name: Electric Potential and Potential Difference
concepts.description: Work done in moving a unit electric charge between two points in a circuit (V = W / Q)

concepts.name: Ohm's Law and Resistance
concepts.description: Direct proportionality between potential difference and current at constant temperature (V = I R)

concepts.name: Resistance in Series and Parallel
concepts.description: Equivalent resistance for series and parallel resistor networks

concepts.name: Joule's Heating Effect
concepts.description: Heat generated by current passing through a resistor (H = I^2 R t)

concepts.name: Electric Power
concepts.description: Rate at which electrical energy is consumed or dissipated (P = V I = I^2 R = V^2 / R)

concepts.name: Magnetic Fields and Field Lines
concepts.description: Concept of magnetic field, field lines around a bar magnet and current-carrying straight conductor

concepts.name: Magnetic Field due to a Solenoid
concepts.description: Uniform magnetic field produced inside a long cylindrical coil carrying current

concepts.name: Force on a Current Conductor and Fleming's Rules
concepts.description: Magnetic force on a moving charge/conductor and Fleming's Left-Hand and Right-Hand rules
